name: Voice perceived-intelligence research Ridge baseline
target: Mean of five 1–7 adapted perceived-intelligence items after watching six voice-assistant vignettes

coding.age_years: Age at source study, computed as 2024 minus birth year; prediction input should be age in years, not birth year
coding.diverse_gender: Source diverse-gender category indicator; 0 otherwise; only five participants, no subgroup validation
coding.owner: 1 owns a smart speaker, 0 does not; not general voice-assistant exposure
coding.information_search: Mean frequency 1–7 over five named services among owners; null for nonowners

limitations: Modest or absent transfer improvement over a constant baseline; see results/voice_prediction.csv
Inputs do not measure factual accuracy, task success, latency or repair behavior
Only UK English-language vignette judgments, not direct voice interaction
All-data final fit is not independently evaluated
No calibrated individual predictive interval is available
Do not interpret demographic coefficients as causal effects or use for consequential decisions
training_procedure: Five-fold inner CV on full released n553; alpha chosen on MAE; imputation/scaling inside pipeline; fit performed after assessment
output: Unclipped linear estimate on nominal 1–7 rating scale, not probability
